Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You have told us you can take on additional parts at short notice; it sounds like steadier business would put that available capacity to good use. We value the relationship and are prepared to make a longer commitment in return for a competitive price for the complete kit. How can you translate that commitment into a bundle discount?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.94 a fair kit price. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.60. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.94 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
Here is the background.
We value your decision to consolidate this volume with us and commit to a 24-month term.
We have factored the verified index development and your volume forecast into our calculation to offer a further discount.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.46 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You have already factored our forecast into your price, yet still ask for a binding commitment—it sounds like certainty of demand is the key to further savings. We want a straightforward, lasting agreement that gives you dependable kit business. How can that contractual certainty translate into a stronger bundle discount?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. As calculated, your own current prices give EUR 5.95 per kit; our offer reflects a fair bundle discount for a multi-year single-source agreement. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 5.12 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
